text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval for removal of an on-street accessible parking space on the north side of Eileen Avenue.

The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing designated on-street accessible parking space in effect at all times on the north side of Eileen Avenue, from a point 8.5 metres east of Lydon Avenue to a point 6 metres further east.
